description: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer or related proton-transfer tautomerization contributes to emission, quenching, dual emission, or AIE behavior.
positive_evidence: dual emission or large Stokes shift linked to target molecule

triage_policy.high: Primary molecule-level paper with ESIPT-specific structural, spectral, or computational evidence.
triage_policy.medium: Likely ESIPT/AIE paper with incomplete snippets.
triage_policy.reject: Review or no target-specific ESIPT evidence.
